name: doctor-git-probes-honor-gitroot
title: Route lattice doctor git probes through the resolved gitRoot
description: 5th residual of the gitRoot resolution defect class (Bug 1 / B-2856). `lattice doctor` runs git with cwd=root (the metadataRoot) at several probe sites instead of the configured gitRoot, so on a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot != gitRoot, e.g. ClawCreek where gitRoot=clawcreek and the wrapper root is not a git repo) it prints two leading `fatal: not a git repository` lines. The failures are caught (each git call is in try/catch and degrades gracefully) so functionality is unaffected — this is cosmetic stderr noise only. Affected sites (cwd:root, no gitRoot resolution): doctor.ts:505 scanTrackedRuntimeArtifacts (git ls-files -z), doctor.ts:554 orphan-worktree scan (git rev-parse --show-toplevel), doctor.ts:760 + :773 the B-854c metadata-protection probe (git ls-files / git check-ignore). The one already-correct site is doctor.ts:93 evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot (B-198c, never throws) — reuse that gitRoot resolution. Outcome: doctor's git probes resolve the configured gitRoot and run from it (falling back to root when no gitRoot resolves, preserving graceful catch behavior), so wrapper-root projects get a clean doctor report with no fatal noise. Scope: doctor.ts git-probe cwd resolution + quieting only; do not change what the probes check or any other gitRoot site already fixed by B-2856.
